entities.summary: Conversion, a notable figure in the history of Fiji, associated with Cakobau and Fijian Unification (1835–1874). Preceded by Methodist Missions and Rise of Cakobau. Their legacy influenced Fiji Cession 1874 and Cession to Britain.
